summary: 3D Silk Road trade strategy on a map of Anatolia, redesigned with a warm dune palette and a parchment travel-journal UI, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Anadolu haritasında 3D İpek Yolu ticaret stratejisi, sıcak kum paleti ve parşömen seyir defteri arayüzüyle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Seven cities with a living market; prices drift and react to what you and three rival merchants sell
Redesign: the plateau rises from a dune sea with sandstone strata, palm oases, wind-blown sand and drifting cloud shadows
Redesign: pacing camels with saddle blankets, night camps with tents and embers, and a parchment and stitched-leather UI with the Marcellus display face
Goal: 10,000 akçe and 3 caravanserais before the end of year five; bandits, guards and caravanserais along the roads
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps, 25 -> 29 draw calls; the ?auto bot still wins (day 212 for seed 3, day 142 for seed 5) with 0 JS errors

social.headline: Lead camel caravans across Anatolia: buy low, sell high, build caravanserais · Deve kervanlarıyla Anadolu'da ucuza al, pahalıya sat, kervansaray kur
